name: Pasrur

queries.query: Pasrur Pakistan cadastral map parcel land records official
queries.result: First-party results identified the Sialkot district Revenue Department Pasrur page, the Punjab Land Records Authority, and the official Ask for Taqseem parcel viewer/API. The local page evidences a Pasrur Arazi Record Center and land-record custodian functions; no safe public parcel polygon was obtained.

queries.result: First-party search identified the official Punjabi/Urdu Punjab land-record portal and Pasrur’s Urdu tehsil/mauza records through the official API route. No anonymous safe parcel geometry response was obtained.

registryEvidence.custodian: Sialkot District Revenue Department / Pasrur Revenue Department, with the Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA) Arazi Record Center network.
registryEvidence.locality: The official Sialkot district page identifies the Pasrur Arazi Record Center and states that it registers mutations, issues Fard Malkiat, maintains ownership and tilling records, and supervises the service center.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: This evidences a local revenue/cadastre custodian and public service procedure, not public citywide parcel geometry access or complete coverage.

parcelDiscovery.note: The official viewer HTML and Swagger configuration were inspected. The viewer advertises GetAdminBoundariesGeoJson and GetParcelGeoJson, but both public GETs returned the 5278-byte viewer HTML with text/html rather than GeoJSON. The documented public API exposed district, tehsil, and mauza lookup routes; district 32 returned Sialkot, tehsil 107 returned Pasrur (پسرور), and mauza 66330 returned Pasrur (پسرور). A bounded GET to GetDistinctKhewatsByMauzaId/66330 returned HTTP 500. No parcel ID plus geometry response was obtained, so no GeoJSON was retained.
